id.description: The id of the the node

label.description: The label when displaying the node

level.description: The placement of the node. In a horizontal Sankey, level 0 is the far left side

value.description: The value of the node which decides the width of the node

color.description: The specification for a field on the data type that is used in determining Sankey node colors.

defaultOpacity.description: The default opacity for this node that is overwritten when a node/edge is hovered over

title: Type to represent the Sankey node data spec
name: UiSdlSankeyChartNodeDataSpec
